title: Time words
descriptionFa: زمان نسبت به حالا، قیدهای تکرار (always, never…)، و عبارت‌های زمانی.

words.example: I lived in Shiraz, but now I live in Tehran.
I was born in Rasht. Then we moved to Karaj.
words.tipFa: با than (از، در مقایسه) قاطی نشه.

words.example: The film starts at eight o'clock.
words.tipFa: فقط برای ساعت کامل: at 8 o'clock، نه 8.30 o'clock.

words.example: I got up four hours ago.
words.tipFa: بعد از زمان میاد: two years ago، نه ago two years.

words.example: We went to Isfahan last month.
words.tipFa: بدون the و بدون in: last week، نه in the last week.

words.example: I'm starting a new job next week.
In the past, people didn't have mobile phones.
Don't worry about tomorrow. Enjoy the present.
Maybe people will live on Mars in the future.
It always snows in the mountains in winter.
words.tipFa: قیدهای تکرار قبل از فعل اصلی میان: I always walk to work.

words.example: It often rains in Rasht.
I sometimes go swimming on Fridays.
We occasionally eat out, but usually we cook at home.
words.tipFa: now and then هم همین معنی رو داره.

words.example: My father rarely watches TV.
I never drink coffee at night.
words.tipFa: با فعل منفی نمیاد: I never drink، نه I don't never drink.

words.example: I go swimming once a week.
words.tipFa: دو بار: twice. سه بار: three times.

words.example: Clean your teeth twice a day.
Please wait. I'll be with you in a moment.
She's in Paris at the moment.
Dinner will be ready soon.
I've recently started learning Spanish.

gapQuestions.sentence: We went to Kish ___ summer. It was very hot!
I'm a vegetarian. I ___ eat meat.
My mother isn't here ___. She's at work.
I visit my grandparents ___ a week, on Fridays.
Our new teacher started ___, about two weeks ago.
Nobody knows what will happen in ___.
It ___ rains in the desert. Maybe once a year.
My English exam is ___ week, so I'm studying hard.
I ___ wear a seat belt in the car. Every time!
